implementation_classes.SIMULATE_ON_GRID: cognitive function executed by one or more interchangeable small-model modules
implementation_classes.STORE_IN_DB: durable exact queryable state is canonical outside simulation
implementation_classes.DETERMINISTIC_BOUNDARY: non-model authority/control logic; may route/admit/commit but does not become a cognitive agent
implementation_classes.EXTERNAL_STRONG_MODEL_BRIDGE: observable bridge to Claude Code strong-model/tool/code surface
implementation_classes.OPTIONAL_CAUSAL_RESEARCH: model-specific causal research path; absence or uncertainty yields no claim

processes.name: TASK_CONTEXT_ADMISSION
processes.role: Admit user/environment/autonomous input into replay-stable causal task/context identity before cognition.
processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: DURABLE_STATE_RETRIEVAL
processes.role: Retrieve exact durable memory/task/evidence/configuration state with provenance; retrieval never upgrades generated content to fact.
processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: WORKING_STATE_RECONSTRUCTION
processes.role: Reconstruct current working state from admitted task plus bounded durable-state projections.
processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: ATTENTION_RELEVANCE_SELECTION
processes.role: Select relevant state/evidence/work units under bounded capacity without discarding unresolved alternatives as false.
processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: GOAL_STATE_MAINTENANCE
processes.role: Maintain current goals, subgoals, completion conditions and state transitions as cognitive candidates bound to durable goal/config state.
processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: PLANNING_DECOMPOSITION_REPLANNING
processes.role: Generate and revise ordered/dependency-bound cognitive work units with explicit preconditions and falsifiers.
processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: ALTERNATIVES_HYPERPOSITION
processes.role: Preserve competing hypotheses/continuations with uncertainty and discriminators; recurrence or majority cannot mint truth.
processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: COGNITIVE_INFERENCE
processes.role: Perform bounded small-model cognitive transforms for a typed work unit; outputs are candidates only.
processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: SELF_EVALUATION_CONTRADICTION
processes.role: Critique candidate outputs for contradiction, evidence coverage, stale state, unsupported authority, and UNKNOWN/negative-evidence confusion.
processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: GLOBAL_WORKSPACE_COMPETITION_BROADCAST_REENTRY
processes.role: Compete/select/broadcast cognitive content and causally re-enter selected state across modules without creating canonical truth.
processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: VARIABLE_GRID_ROUTING_SCHEDULING
processes.role: Route typed cognitive work across runtime-variable N using capability/resource evidence; no fixed personality or node identity defines a process.
processes.falsifier: Fails if the process changes semantic identity solely because N or physical executor identity changes.

processes.name: GRID_STATE_TRANSFER_COMPRESSION
processes.role: Compress/translate reusable cognitive state for transfer across modules while preserving causal/provenance bindings and explicit loss markers.
processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HANDOFF

processes.falsifier: Fails if generated/model/workspace content is promoted to canonical fact or real effect without the deterministic authority boundary.

processes.name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESULT_RECONCILIATION

processes.name: MEMORY_UPDATE_PROPOSAL

processes.name: TOOL_EFFECT_PROPOSAL
